notes: DRAFT for C2: Sensei's Question at the Bow, redone as RECALL (Jay, docs/decisions.md K1). Same file and top-level keys as before (notes, skipText, watchText, questions). Sensei shows a picture of one of the player's earned abilities (any earned one, not only the newest; docs/curriculum.md) and asks its name. 'choices': 'earned' = 3 picture-and-word choices: the right one plus 2 other abilities, all shown by their real name from abilities/technique-callouts.json. If fewer than 3 abilities are earned, fill with locked ones the player has seen on the Gate. {name} = the right real name. After any answer, the character performs the move. A wrong answer warmly shows the right name; there is no penalty. Correct answers are counted forever; 'awards' play at 5, 10, 20, 50 and 100 (the list can grow). At most one question per day. 'Not now' is always there. Lines are one short sentence each. The first movement lesson ('Tap where you want to go, or use the stick.') is already in tutorial/first-session-lessons.json (lesson-move). Manager calls (after PR #66): locked abilities the player has seen on the Gate are APPROVED as filler choices. Every award gives a badge; the 50 award also gives a decoration and the 100 award also gives a title. Names are drafts; art is A3.

correct: That's right. {name}, just like in class.
wrong: This one is {name}. Now you know it.
